definition: anything that lifts -- light, sound, motion, virtues, abstractions; radiance, echo, currents, flight, courage, patience, patterns, ideas, music, weather-of-feeling, and abstract nouns all belong. A word belongs if a person would hear it as something that lifts or that is not merely physical.

_provenance.theme_definition: anything that lifts -- light, sound, motion, virtues, abstractions. WIDE by design: a mnemonic FLAVOUR, not a taxonomy.
_provenance.dictionary_check: grep -x <word> /usr/share/dict/words for every shipped word; 100% present
rules: no proper nouns (the dictionary capitalises proper nouns, so a case-sensitive lowercase match cannot return one)
_provenance.membership_rule: WordNet 3.0 evidence: (A) a sense in the abstraction subtree (00002137) whose lexicographer class is not a physical-object class, OR (B) a sense descending from a lifting-domain synset (light, sound, music, motion, feeling, virtue, mind, thought, memory, speech, time, pattern, relation), OR (C) a quality/relational adjective formation. Words whose senses are physical-object classes (animal, plant, substance, object, artifact, body, food, location, shape, weather, quantity, person) are excluded so NATURE and PEOPLE keep their words.
_provenance.note: Counts are measured from the shipped arrays. Letters that cannot reach 400 are reported as reached, never padded: no coinages, no proper nouns, no invented words.

banned_stem_removal.removed_word: withheld from this data file (naming it here would re-introduce the banned stem)
